text:
rachel: Flagging a weird one from this morning's interviewer shadow: some panels saw the numeric scoring scale reversed (1=best, 5=worst) while others saw the intended 1=worst,5=best. Happened across desktop web and the mobile reviewer app.

rachel: I checked the ATS event and the scorecard payload includes `scale_direction: "asc"` which is our canonical 1->best mapping.

maya: yikes. Any recent changes to the scorecard serializer or the mobile SDK?

tom: i pushed a change last week to the mobile scoring widget to support RTL languages. accidentally introduced logic that flips the visual scale when a locale flag is set. looks like a bug where locale detection failed and defaulted to "rtl-mode" for some users.

ats-bot: webhook: interview.opened id=20455 received at 2026-06-02T09:47:56Z. scorecard_version=v5 locale=en-US

lisa: impact: 8 live panels; 4 debriefs already submitted. risk: inconsistent scoring and calibration drift. we need to surface which interviewers saw the flipped UI.

rachel: can we run a query on the review events? look for scoring_ui_variant=rtl and reviewer_agent like "mobile%" or agent string containing "ReviewerApp/"

maya: running query now. preliminary: 11 reviewers had the rtl rendering flag set in the client heartbeat between 09:30-10:10. 5 of those submitted scores. posting secure IDs to people-ops.

tom: immediate mitigation: i'll push a remote-config toggle to force-ltr for all reviewer clients and roll a patch to remove the locale fallback. deploying now.

people-ops-bot: ticket created: RECRUIT-2334 "scorecard UI scale flipped due to locale fallback" assigned to tom,maya.

lisa: recruiting ops: please pause acceptance of debriefs for the affected interviews until we can determine whether to re-open, convert scores, or request re-submission.

rachel: noted — pausing debriefs and messaging hiring managers. adding a short note in the calendar invites: "Hold: scoring UI inconsistency detected. Please wait for ops guidance before submitting debriefs."

tom: can we programmatically detect flipped scales and auto-normalize submitted scores? if 1->5 mapping differs from canonical, we could invert the numeric values for affected submissions.

maya: possible but need care: some debriefs have freeform comments tied to specific numeric anchors. auto-inverting could misrepresent written feedback. suggestion: flag submissions for manual review and provide a one-click invert tool in the debrief admin UI.

lisa: good compromise. we should: 1) Surface flagged debriefs in a review queue 2) Provide invert preview and approve 3) Notify interviewer when inversion applied.

tom: i'll scope the admin tool as a small UI change + a DB migration to add a "flipped_ui_detected" boolean on review events. aiming for a canary tonight.

maya: follow-ups: 1) engineering to patch mobile widget to stop defaulting to rtl 2) add an automated end-to-end test that renders scorecards under multiple locale/agent combos and asserts numeric direction 3) people-ops to run an audit of debriefs from the last 24h for anomalies.

rachel: thanks team. appreciate the fast reaction. will coordinate comms to affected candidates/hiring managers once we have the remediation path. :white_check_mark:
